capabilities: search selected text on external websites
search the internet using a note's title from the file context menu
search on internal and external links via right-click
add custom search websites with URL templates
restrict search options to notes with specific tags
extras: README warns that the right-click menu is broken in the latest Obsidian release so the plugin will not work as expected, and states Obsidian v0.10.11 or later is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up the current note's title or selected text on external websites without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Settings code is mainly taken from the Templater plugin by SilentVoid13
Modal code is inspired by the Citation plugin

summary: Context-menu web search that sends selected text, note titles, or links to configurable external sites, shown in an iframe or the default browser.
